title: usage() does not list the new dublin-grown verb
evidence:
harness/main.odin:456 (read verbatim):
	fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png] | dublin-shot [outdir] | wire-preview [outdir] | motion-strip <demo> <start_ms> <end_ms> <step_ms> <outdir> [snapshot] | motion-pixel")
The diff's own verb block documents (harness/main.odin:123):
			// harness dublin-grown [outdir] [ms]   (default bin/dublin-grown + the demo duration)
dublin-shot is listed; dublin-grown is absent from the usage string.
detail: Every other harness verb, including the sibling dublin-shot, is listed in usage(); the new dublin-grown verb is not, so `harness` with no args won't reveal it.
recommended_fix: Add `| dublin-grown [outdir] [ms]` to the usage() line in harness/main.odin, after `dublin-shot [outdir]`.

title: dublin-grown audit header prints node_count (routers included) labeled 'live terminals'
evidence:
harness/dublin_shot.odin:195:
	fmt.printfln("dublin-grown: %d ticks played, %d live terminals", ticks, pp.node_count(&state.topology))
core/topology.odin:76-80:
node_count :: proc(t: ^Topology) -> int {
	n := 0
	for alive in t.node_alive { if alive { n += 1 } }
	return n
}
demos/dublin_board.dem:33-34:
spawn_node router_high 20 15
spawn_node router_high 16 12
docs/captures/v2-dublin-spawn-director/spawn-audit.txt line 1 vs line 16:
dublin-grown: 1800 ticks played, 17 live terminals
...
dublin-grown: 15 live terminals across 52 districts
detail: node_count counts ALL live nodes; the demo carries 2 routers, so the committed gate artifact reads '17 live terminals' then '15 live terminals' — self-inconsistent evidence for the KYLE grader.
recommended_fix: Count terminals (node_alive && node_kind == .Terminal) for line 195, or relabel the field 'live nodes' — the district loop already counts terminals correctly.

title: district_tiles partition loop copy-pasted into three test fixtures instead of one shared helper
detail: Four copies of the partition construction; a fixture that forgets the copy leaves district_tiles empty and growth_board_seed_draw bounds-traps on district_tiles[d].
recommended_fix: Extract a proc beside map_district_assign (e.g. map_district_partition(b, allocator)) and call it from the loader and all three fixture builders.

title: Spec artifact claims 602 pool tiles / 518 suburban; the real loader yields 603 / 517
evidence:
spec-v2-dublin-spawn-director.md lines 12-13:
  The pool IS the stride-6 subsample of the asset's street-adjacent points
  (snapped + deduped + grid-filtered at load: **602 pool tiles**).
spec line 139-140:
0.002 — the core is ~400× richer per tile than the suburban fabric, which
is the "dense-core districts richer" ruling, while the absolute map still
reads suburban-dominant (518 of 602 pool tiles) — the gallery's read.
Measured with the repo's own core at this sha (Odin probe calling map_board_load on data/maps/dublin.json): prints `pool=603 districts=52`; per-kind partition: suburb=517, total=603. The committed spawn-audit.txt per-district pools (Raheny 67, Grangegorman 4, etc.) DO replicate exactly, so only the spec totals are off.
detail: The diff's spec/canon artifact misstates the pool size it derives its density math narrative from; committed audit numbers are correct, spec totals are not.
recommended_fix: Correct the spec figures to 603 pool tiles and 517 suburban (or whatever the blessed asset yields at the review sha).

title: dublin_shot_capture doc comment ('The topology is EMPTY') now wrong for its new grown-board caller
detail: After this change the helper serves two framings (pure underlay + grown board); the EMPTY-topology claim is stale for the gate path it was extended for.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to cover both callers (e.g. 'topology empty for dublin-shot; the full grown topology for dublin-grown').
